title: Scorpion landing page events
description: Two schemas in one file. The root (#/$defs/event) is one event file, events/<id>.yaml. #/$defs/feed is events.json, the asset of the rolling `events` release that scripts/build-events.mjs writes and the host fetches (docs/plan.md §4). Rules a schema can't express are checked by scripts/build-events.mjs and src/lib/events.ts: `start` and `end` are real calendar dates of the same kind, `end` is not before `start`, the id equals the file name and is unique, and `url` parses as an https: URL.

when.description: A date `YYYY-MM-DD` (all-day, a day in Europe/Berlin) or a date-time with seconds optional and an offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS](Z|+HH:MM|-HH:MM)`.

id.description: Equals the file name without .yaml, for example `denbi-plenary-2027`.

start.description: First day, or the start time.

end.description: Last day (inclusive), or the end time. Same kind as `start` and not before it. The event is past after the end of this day in Europe/Berlin, or after this instant.

location.description: Where the event takes place, the same in both languages, for example `Göttingen` or `Online`.

feed.description: events.json: the upcoming events at the time it was built, sorted by start and then id. Clients still drop events whose end has passed since.
